author: IGN YouTube
text:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Gunny Loadout System Explained
If you’ve ever felt like Call of Duty’s weapon customization requires a degree in spreadsheet management just to build a decent loadout, Modern Warfare 4 has a new solution for you. Enter Gunny, a brand-new tool designed to remove the friction of the traditional Gunsmith. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned veteran, Gunny allows you to simply pick a gun and a preferred playstyle—like long-range, balanced, or close-quarters—and instantly equips a tailored, usable weapon setup based on the attachments you've unlocked.

In this video, we break down exactly how the Gunny system works in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. We explore how you can reroll playstyles to get completely different attachment combinations, swap out individual parts like a drum mag while keeping the overall build intact, and why it won't replace traditional full Gunsmith customization for those who still want total manual control. Gunny proves to be a surprisingly effective addition to the loadout process that gets you into multiplayer matches faster without hamstringing your options.

text:
The Witcher 3 Remastered Will Be Free for All Owners - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
If you need something to hold you over until The Witcher 4 drops in 2028, why not play through The Witcher 3 again? CD Projekt is dropping The Witcher 3 Remastered in September, and it will include everything in The Wild Hunt base game, plus the two existing expansions Blood & Wine and and Hearts of Stone. A third expansion, Songs of the Past, will be released next year. Current owners of The Witcher 3 can upgrade their copy for free (yes, even the Switch 1 version, but only if you have a Switch 2 console). Plus, we have details on the Enhanced version of Crimson Desert, which includes new story content. And we’re heading back to How to Train Your Dragon’s Isle of Berk with the Ride Guys to soar through Hiccup’s Wing Gliders – all at Universal Orlando Resort.

Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.

text:
Guns of Eschaton Hands-On Preview | Gamescom 2026
Guns of Eschaton is reinventing both the first-person shooter and the soulslike genre alike, all for the genre's most masochistic fans! In this hands-on gamescom 2026 preview, we experienced two hours of gunpowder-heavy FPS action, set in an apocalyptic Weird West designed by the late great Viktor Antonov (known for being the art director on Dishonored, Half-Life 2, Wolfenstein: The New Order, and now Guns of Eschaton). Despite an arduous demo and a never-ending array of horrors, Guns of Eschaton offers an entrancing yet brutal world that makes you want to "git gud".
